requirements.title: Software Development Lifecycle
requirements.description: Involved in all aspects of the software development lifecycle, from initial concept and design to testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has experience in designing, developing, and maintaining business intelligence applications, covering various stages of the SDLC.

requirements.title: Coding Skills
requirements.description: Write clean, scalable, and efficient code using established development practices and conventions.
requirements.explanation: Proficient in JavaScript/React for frontend and Python/Flask for backend, indicating strong coding skills.

requirements.title: Testing and Debugging
requirements.description: Conduct unit and integration testing and perform debugging to ensure strong functionality, optimal performance, and security.
requirements.explanation: Has a proven track record of troubleshooting complex issues and implementing RBAC systems, indicating strong testing and debugging skills.

requirements.title: Documentation
requirements.description: Create and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications and code functionality, throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
requirements.explanation: Maintains comprehensive technical documentation for all projects and shares knowledge through LinkedIn articles.

requirements.title: Collaboration
requirements.description: Participate in code reviews, daily stand-ups, and sprint planning sessions within an Agile/Scrum environment. Work with designers, analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure project goals are met.
requirements.explanation: Demonstrates collaborative approach in cross-functional teams to deliver business intelligence solutions.

requirements.title: Learning and Adaptability
requirements.description: Stay up-to-date with new technologies, trends, and best practices to continuously enhance skills and improve development efficiency.
requirements.explanation: Shows a passion for learning and writing about tech, indicating a commitment to staying updated and adaptable.

wishes.title: Cloud Platform Experience
wishes.description: Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is often desirable.
wishes.explanation: Has experience with AWS S3 and EC2, covering some aspects of cloud platform requirements.

wishes.title: Full-Stack Web Development
wishes.description: Knowledge of full-stack web development, including HTML, CSS, and frameworks like React or Angular, may be required depending on the role.
wishes.explanation: Proficient in React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 for frontend development, fulfilling the full-stack web development requirement.
